description: Live-gateway shape: the gateway federates tools as "<server-prefix>-<op>" and slugifies underscores to hyphens, so the tool arrives as "ucp-shop-complete-checkout" — no underscore survives. This fixture proves the policy still matches (an underscore-only suffix match would fail open here). Scenario otherwise identical to deny.json: Procurement: agent completes a checkout totalling $1,390.00 (139000 minor units) against a PO ceiling of $1,200.00 (max_total 120000, USD). Total exceeds the cap, so the policy denies with a human-readable reason and the charge never reaches the merchant.

expected.reasonContains: This purchase totals $1,390.00 but the agent's limit is $1,200.00
